[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Dinner ideas:

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Dessert ideas:  
1. Cheesecake: Creamy cheesecake filling on a graham cracker crust.  
2. Ice Cream Sundae: Ice cream topped with whipped cream, chocolate sauce, nuts, or fruit.
